name: spendesk-auto
description: Completes Spendesk expenses before the 3-day fuse blocks the card: fills the mandatory fields, writes the description, fetches and attaches the invoice, and asks about whatever it cannot know.

scripts.schedule: ln -sf "$(pwd)/launchd/com.theodo.spendesk.plist" ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl load -w ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.theodo.spendesk.plist && echo 'Scheduled: runs daily at 08:00'
scripts.serve:schedule: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.theodo.spendesk.trigger 2>/dev/null; cp launchd/com.theodo.spendesk.trigger.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.theodo.spendesk.trigger.plist && launchctl kickstart gui/$(id -u)/com.theodo.spendesk.trigger && echo "Trigger listener: running"
scripts.serve:unschedule: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.theodo.spendesk.trigger 2>/dev/null; rm -f ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.theodo.spendesk.trigger.plist && echo "Trigger listener stopped"
